snippet.title: Echoes of a Thread — Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Echoes of a Thread is a short story-rich indie RPG where every boss fight is a puzzle.
Free • No ads • No microtransactions • No IAP

▶ Download on :
itch.io: https://alexiscgames.itch.io/echoes-of-a-thread
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414420/Echoes_of_a_Thread/
Play Store : Coming soon
PC (EN/FR) • Android APK (EN)

Turn-based boss rush: pattern-focused fights

The first ending is only the beginning

Lo-fi OST: boss themes + ambience

Content note: dark themes (violence, psychological themes, depression).



Echoes of a Thread est un RPG indé court où chaque boss est un puzzle—et l’histoire se cache à la vue de tous.
Gratuit • Sans pubs • Sans microtransactions • Sans achats intégrés

▶ Télécharger sur :
itch.io: https://alexiscgames.itch.io/echoes-of-a-thread
Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4414420/Echoes_of_a_Thread/
Play Store : Bientôt disponible
PC (EN/FR) • Android APK (EN)

Note de contenu : thèmes sombres (violence, thèmes psychologiques, dépression).
